target: repo-truth-extractor / write-time secret scrub — make F-23 leakage structurally impossible
invariants: DRY-RUN ONLY: never pass --execute; never set DPMX_LIVE_OK; no live provider calls.

CONTEXT: TP-RTE-TRUTH-R3-004 (commit 6aac1ef79) made redaction BINDING at the prompt layer, but redaction is an INSTRUCTION, not an ENFORCEMENT. A non-compliant model still writes real secrets into SECRETS_RISK_LOCATIONS.json and into downstream R11 security synthesis. R3-004's own author flagged this as the top follow-up and recommended it before F-23 is treated as closed.

VERIFIED PRECONDITION: output_safety.sanitize_payload_for_output IS already imported and called at run_extraction_v5.py:2624, but SECRETS_RISK_LOCATIONS is NOT referenced anywhere in output_safety.py or the artifact write path — confirm this trace yourself before designing.
Redaction regexes already exist (lib/truth_labels + output_safety _SECRET_PATTERNS) — REUSE them; do not author a third copy (see TP-RTE-TRUTH-D-004 which consolidates the existing two).
Fail-closed: if a secret pattern matches at write time, mask it. Do not drop the finding — the location is the value, the secret value is not.

commit.message: fix(rte): TP-RTE-TRUTH-R3-007 — write-time secret scrub for SECRETS_RISK_LOCATIONS

pr.title: fix(rte): write-time secret scrub (F-23 enforcement)
pr.body: Closes the enforcement half of F-23: R3-004 made redaction binding in the prompt, this makes non-compliance structurally harmless by scrubbing secret spans at artifact write time.

steps.task: Trace where SECRETS_RISK_LOCATIONS.json (and other C8/H1/H7/M safe-export artifacts) are written; determine why the existing sanitize_payload_for_output call at v5:2624 does not cover them.
requirements: Report the actual write path; do not assume the 2624 call is the only one.
validation: Write path identified and documented in PROOF.json.

steps.task: Apply the existing secret-pattern scrub to the SECRETS artifact write path so a non-compliant model's raw secret is masked before it reaches disk or downstream synthesis.
requirements: Reuse existing regexes. Preserve the finding (path/line/type); mask only the secret span.
commands: mise exec -- python -m pytest services/repo-truth-extractor/tests/ -q -k 'redact or secret'
validation: A simulated non-compliant model payload containing a FAKE secret is masked at write time.

steps.task: MUTATION-CHECK the test: remove the scrub and confirm the test fails with the fake secret visible in the artifact. A test that passes without the scrub is vacuous.
requirements: Never use a real secret in tests.
Document the mutation result in PROOF.json.
validation: Mutation check documented; goldens verified (not assumed) unchanged.
